text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
QADISSIYA
- Cabinet holds meeting under President Saddam Hussein and reviews results of visit by Foreign Minister Mohammed Saeed al-Sahaf to New York.
- Cabinet discusses results of visits by Saddam's envoys to a number of Arab countries.
- Cabinet reviews ways of improving agricultural yields in the southern city of Fao.
- Cabinet discusses a number of financial and economic issues and decides to let private banks deal in hard cash.
- Iraq holds Saudi Arabia and Kuwait responsible for violations by allied warplanes of its airspace.
- Iraqi delegation under Foreign Ministry Undersecretary Abdulmajeed al-Feisal arrives in Ankara.
- Foreign Minister al-Sahaf sends message to his Qatari counterpart.
- National Assembly Speaker Saadon Hammadi receive Italian MPs.
- Iraqi trade and industrial delegation to visit Cairo to expand bilateral ties.
- (The above were also carried by AL-THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Article on ways to rationalise expenditures and boost production.
- Article on the principlies laid down by Saddam for the development of the Third World.
THAWRA
- Commentary lambasts British Foreign Sectretary Malcolm Rifkind for anti-Iraq remarks he made during last visit to Saudi Arabia.
- Article on the meanings and connotations of the mother of battles, the 1991 Gulf War over Kuwait.
- Iraqi citizen donates 600 million dinars (about $600,000) for the construction of a medical college at Anbar University.
- Iraqis urged to rationalise power consumption.
JUMHOURIYA
- Article on Iran's involvement in the disturbances that took place in Iraq after the end of the 1991 Gulf War over Kuwait.
- Article on ways of protecting national industries.
